SCHEMA:
- dim_date(date_key INTEGER, full_date DATE, year SMALLINT, quarter SMALLINT, month SMALLINT, month_name VARCHAR, iso_week SMALLINT, day_of_week SMALLINT, is_weekend BOOLEAN)
- dim_gene(gene_key INTEGER, gene_symbol VARCHAR, chromosome VARCHAR)
- dim_pipeline(pipeline_key INTEGER, family VARCHAR, tool VARCHAR, version VARCHAR, valid_from DATE, valid_to DATE, is_current BOOLEAN, caller_taxon_key INTEGER, filter_taxon_key INTEGER)
- dim_sample(sample_key INTEGER, sample_code VARCHAR, cohort VARCHAR, tissue VARCHAR, platform VARCHAR, batch VARCHAR, qc_status VARCHAR)
- dim_taxon(taxon_key INTEGER, iri VARCHAR, notation VARCHAR, label VARCHAR, label_uk VARCHAR, level SMALLINT, parent_key INTEGER, top_label VARCHAR, facet_label VARCHAR, path VARCHAR, is_leaf BOOLEAN)
- fact_pipeline_day(date_key INTEGER, pipeline_key INTEGER, runs_started INTEGER, cpu_hours DOUBLE, queue_backlog DOUBLE)
- fact_variant_call(call_id INTEGER, date_key INTEGER, sample_key INTEGER, gene_key INTEGER, pipeline_key INTEGER, variant_type_key INTEGER, origin_key INTEGER, significance_key INTEGER, call_count INTEGER, is_pass INTEGER, review_minutes DOUBLE, read_depth INTEGER, qual DOUBLE, alt_fraction DOUBLE)
JOINS: fact_variant_call.{date_key->dim_date, sample_key->dim_sample, gene_key->dim_gene, pipeline_key->dim_pipeline, variant_type_key|origin_key|significance_key->dim_taxon.taxon_key}; fact_pipeline_day.{date_key->dim_date, pipeline_key->dim_pipeline}.
TAXONOMY ROLES: variant type = dim_taxon rows with facet_label='genetic variant' (labels: single nucleotide polymorphism, insertion-deletion, structural variant, copy number variation); origin: 'germline variant','somatic variant'; significance: 'pathogenic variant','benign variant','variant of uncertain significance'.
SCD2: dim_pipeline has one row per tool version (valid_from, valid_to, is_current); families: GATK, BCFTOOLS, STRELKA, DEEPVARIANT. Data cover 2025-01-01..2026-09-30.
METRICS (use these definitions):
- call_count: Number of called variants (rows of the fact at the grain "one call"). SQL: count(*) (fact: fact_variant_call; additive)
- pass_rate: Share of calls that passed the pipeline filter. SQL: round(100.0 * sum(f.is_pass) / count(*), 1) (fact: fact_variant_call; non-additive (ratio of two additive sums))
- avg_qual: Mean QUAL over the calls in the group. SQL: round(avg(f.qual), 1) (fact: fact_variant_call; non-additive)
- review_min_per_call: Manual review time divided by the number of calls. SQL: round(sum(f.review_minutes) / count(*), 2) (fact: fact_variant_call; non-additive (ratio))
- pathogenic_share: Share of calls whose clinical significance is the taxonomy concept 'pathogenic variant' (C033). SQL: round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN sg_p.notation = 'C033' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) (fact: fact_variant_call; non-additive (ratio))
- cpu_hours: Compute time consumed by pipeline runs. SQL: round(sum(f.cpu_hours), 1) (fact: fact_pipeline_day; additive)
- avg_daily_backlog: Queue backlog summed over the pipelines in a day, averaged over the days of the period. SQL: round(sum(f.queue_backlog) / count(DISTINCT f.date_key), 1) (fact: fact_pipeline_day; semi-additive (sum across pipelines, average across time))
